info.title: E-Commerce Platform API
info.description: Comprehensive REST API for managing an e-commerce platform with products, orders, customers, payments, and inventory management.

changes: Added semantic search capability for products
Introduced file upload support for product images
Added webhook support for order status changes

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of products with optional filtering and sorting

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search query for product name or description

post.description: Add a new product to the catalog. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific product

patch.description: Partially update product information. Requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Remove a product from the catalog. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Retrieve current inventory levels for a product

patch.description: Update stock levels for a product

get.description: Retrieve a list of orders for the authenticated user or all orders (admin)
Retrieve detailed information about a specific order

patch.description: Update the status of an order. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Cancel an order if it hasn't been shipped yet

get.description: Retrieve a list of all customers. Requires admin privileges.

400.description: Invalid input or email already exists

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a customer
Get all addresses for a customer

post.description: Add a new address to a customer account
Process a payment for an order

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific payment

post.description: Process a refund for a payment. Requires admin privileges.
Create a new product category. Requires admin privileges.
Submit a review for a purchased product

get.description: Retrieve all reviews for a specific product
Retrieve sales data and metrics. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Upload one or more product images. Supports multipart/form-data.

alt_texts.description: Alt text for each image (for accessibility)

413.description: File size too large (max 10MB per image)

post.description: Search products using natural language queries powered by AI embeddings.

matched_attributes.description: Product attributes that matched the query

query_interpretation.description: AI interpretation of the search query

get.description: Retrieve customer notification and privacy settings

patch.description: Update customer preferences, notifications, and privacy settings

get.description: Legacy endpoint for order tracking. Use /orders/{orderId} instead.

x-deprecation-info.migration_guide: Use GET /orders/{orderId} which includes tracking information in the response.

post.description: Register a webhook endpoint to receive real-time notifications about events.

secret.description: Secret key for webhook signature verification
